title: RAG on Your Own Machine: A Local Retrieval Walkthrough
description: Build the full retrieve-then-write loop locally: chunking, a resident embeddings model, a JSONL index that graduates to Chroma or Qdrant, and grounded answers with citations.
lead: Retrieval-augmented generation fetches the relevant passages first and hands them to the model with the question. This walkthrough builds all five stages on one consumer GPU: chunking, embedding, storing, retrieving, and generating answers that cite their evidence.
